parts:
Guys, in my "user.r" file - when I encounter some undesirable condition I ask R inside my reactive statement to stop and to give me a certain error on the mainPanel, e.g.:

    if(any(is.na(myinput1)==TRUE)){
      stop("The imported file contains missing values. Please check your input file.")
    }

However, sometimes I want R to print onto mainPanel some other NON-ERROR messages. For example:

if (MYCONDITION IS TRUE) print("Reading European CSV file")
if (MYCONDITION IS FALSE print("Reading US CSV file")

Currently, it's printing on my R console, but not on the mainPanel. How can I make it print my messages (which are NOT errors) on the mainPanel?

Thanks a lot!
Dimitri

Would like to use this panel conditioned on the shiny state - but I am missing something, it just would not work. I minimized my example to the following:

shinyServer(function(input, output, session){
  output$a<-renderText("sleepy")
  observe({ 
    if(input$calculate){
Sys.sleep(5)
output$a<-renderText("slept a while")
}
  })
})

shinyUI(
pageWithSidebar(
headerPanel("test"), sidebarPanel(),
mainPanel(
textOutput("a"),
actionButton("calculate","Calculate"),
conditionalPanel(condition="$('html').attr('class')=='shiny-busy'",
tags$h5("Shiny seems busy...")
)
)
))

Any ideas? It must be something very basic...
Thanks in advance!

Am Montag, 11. November 2013 17:09:24 UTC+1 schrieb Dimitri Liakhovitski:
Guys, in my "user.r" file - when I encounter some undesirable condition I ask R inside my reactive statement to stop and to give me a certain error on the mainPanel, e.g.:

    if(any(is.na(myinput1)==TRUE)){
      stop("The imported file contains missing values. Please check your input file.")
    }

However, sometimes I want R to print onto mainPanel some other NON-ERROR messages. For example:

if (MYCONDITION IS TRUE) print("Reading European CSV file")
if (MYCONDITION IS FALSE print("Reading US CSV file")

Currently, it's printing on my R console, but not on the mainPanel. How can I make it print my messages (which are NOT errors) on the mainPanel?

Thanks a lot!
Dimitri
